hooks.command: bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$BRANCH" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ] && exit 0; git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Branch $BRANCH está pusheado. Verificá si existe una PR y creá una si no hay.\"}"'
